SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...By the way, have you decided where you want to 
go tomorrow?

Due to certain various circumstances... I try to shift 
the conversation away from adult topics.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Hmm... I'd like to visit the Studio Park and Kinkaku-ji 
temple.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I've heard of Kinkaku-ji, it's the "Golden Pavilion". 
But what's this "Studio Park"?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Eeh? Kyou-chan, you don't mean to tell me you 
don't know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Honestly, I only know the name, not what it's about.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I see. I've read this guidebook, there are a variety 
of activities at the Studio Park, you'll enjoy yourself, 
no matter how old you are.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Wow, so they just turned a feudal era movie set 
into an amusement park?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I'm interested to try out the costume rental shop.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
What kind of costume grabbed your interest, 
Manami?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
That's a secret~ It's something to look forward to 
until we get there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, I can't wait.

What outfit is Manami going to wear? Another 
addition to my list of expectations for tomorrow.

But, before that... there seems to be an important 
event that lies in wait.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
*ahem*, Since we have a plan for tomorrow, I 
guess we better get some sleep...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Y-Yeah, you're right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So, uh... Which side do you prefer?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Um, either one's fine for me... How about you, 
Kyou-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Uhh...

Are we seriously having this conversation? Whether 
I want to be on top or bottom, that kind of thing?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Well, if you don't have any preference... I have my 
luggage right here, so I'll be taking this side, okay?

Having said that, she hastily slides into the futon on 
the left.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh... I-I guess I'll sleep on this side then...

Sorry, I might've gotten ahead of myself. Once 
inside the futon, I turn my back towards Manami 
out of embarrassment.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [font_size=17]Good night, Kyou-chan.[/font_size]
Despite that, I could still hear her clearly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Ugh, can't sleep...

I'm laying in my futon, mind still plagued with 
endless worries.
On the other hand, Manami is sound aslee-

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...U-Um, Kyou-chan, are you awake?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? Yeah, still awake. What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You've... collected a lot of points... right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Points? Ah, you mean those points... almost forgot. 
Yeah, there's a bunch.

I think it passed the milestone for another reward 
already...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I-In that case, it's time for a reward for the 
hardworking Kyou-chan!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Huh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Um... Excuse me.

Manami ignores my statement, or rather, just didn't 
hear, and slithers into my futon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, wha... Manami...

The sound of something rustling inside the futon 
sounds so real... Whoa?!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Excuse me~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: "Excuse me"? What in the...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I'm going to sleep in the same futon as you... 
Sleeping together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, you're getting a little close...
Nngg! Crap. My heart's going nuts.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, your back is really big.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: R-Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yup. As expected from a guy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Oh...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: It's big and... I don't know, makes me feel safe.

Does this mean what I think it means!? Alright then, 
the time to become a man has come!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: M-Manami! Wait, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Zzzz... Zzzz...
She just fell asleep!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Zzz... Kyou-chan... manju...
Even in her dreams, she's still giving me manju.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Thanks.

I thank her while smiling wryly. Once again, I sink 
into my futon and close my eyes.
...However.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course I can't sleep!!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Mmmm... Have some... Suama...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
*sigh* Well, at least someone's having a pleasant 
sleep.
It was then I noticed something. That's right...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If... If I kiss her now, will she even notice?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Heeey, Manami. You awake?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Zzz... zzz...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Manami, I...
My gaze shifts to her soft lips... just a little further...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=28]Whoa!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan... I love you... Zzz...zz...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What the... Sleeptalking?

Making moves on her while she's asleep... how 
unfitting of a real man.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Time for bed.
Gotta wake up early, anyway.

Forcing my eyes closed, I eventually drifted off into 
a deep, relaxing slumber.
